decisions.reason: coding-agent harness edits (skills/rules) are trusted after a single success and can degrade behavior | measurement-gated evolution keeps a skill/rule only when repeated with/without runs show net gain; Claude Haiku 4.5 + Sonnet 5, held-out convention-following tasks vs no-skills baseline, planted useless/harmful suggestions never retained

first experimental characterization and modeling of HBM2 DRAM power; JEDEC test loops can underbound power and cause thermal throttling in AI workloads | measurements of 36 real HBM2 chips, new power model at 7.6-8.1% MAPE | excluded: power modeling is not one of the area's listed problems (operators, interconnect, scheduling, failure/straggler detection)

NO-THINK-mode GRPO gains largely reactivate the original THINK mode instead of learning new reasoning: activations shift toward the THINK state during training | GRPO on Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B; replacing a low-dimensional THINK-related activation subspace removes most of the RL gain, and the GRPO advantage signal favors THINK-like responses

4-bit all-reduce rounding error accumulates across tensor-parallel layers | error-compensated all-reduce: 4-bit transfer, high-precision summation, error fed back so accumulated error provably bounded; 2.09x faster than 16-bit NCCL on 1GB messages, Qwen3-8B within 0.4 points of 16-bit, 10B-token pretraining final loss within 0.9%

dataflow accelerators (Cerebras, SambaNova, TPU) are opaque to performance analysis | DFIT instrumentation framework at graph-IR and backend-lowering stages, 3.53-13.62% overhead | excluded: performance instrumentation is not a listed problem of the area (not failure detection, scheduling, operators or interconnect)

decisions.anchor: precision and correctness problems introduced by aggressive optimization of training and inference
decisions.reason: low-step sampling introduces endpoint errors that accumulate and degrade generation quality | TraceSampler predicts and corrects sample-specific endpoint error with a two-stage learned residual vs matched-step Euler; FID 2.692 (CIFAR-10) / 2.189 (ImageNet-256) at 10 steps vs 120-step Heun 2.601/2.056, 24x fewer backbone evaluations, SD3.5 ImageReward 0.752 -> 0.906

zero-shot evaluation of 17 LLMs as Skill LLM executors on mined customer-support workflows; judge agreement Kappa=0.524 | excluded: pure agent benchmark, which the area explicitly rejects

non-monotone feasibility of dynamic tensor rematerialization: budgets where eviction policies OOM although smaller and larger budgets complete | simrd replay of DTR traces, holes on InceptionV4/U-Net/ResNet-32 traced to single-allocation cascades; simulation only, no GPU validation | no listed area problem: memory-scheduler feasibility, not training-run instability or monitoring

energy cost of capability for 86 open-weight checkpoints across 7 benchmarks and 6 hardware platforms; thinking +3.7x energy, FP8 saves ~25%, token count misorders 18-24% of pairs | excluded: energy-efficiency measurement is not a listed problem of the area

decisions.anchor: precision and correctness problems introduced by aggressive optimization of training and inference
decisions.reason: replacing expert computation with cheaper coarse-grained modules degrades downstream quality in ways local fidelity mispredicts | continuation-relative evaluation framework with exact loss decomposition; 1.7B frozen LM: next-token-loss fitting -0.1901 nats vs reconstructing skipped outputs, ranking reverses in 9/9 paired comparisons under distribution shift; jointly adapted expert trails directly trained controls

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: poisoned memory-formation interfaces commit corrupted content that later changes agent behavior, and evaluated defenses only partially mitigate | MemForm with five interface categories (Content/Evidence/Scope/Selection/Path poisoning) and matched controls; 6 LLMs, 2 response formats; consolidation order alters behavior even with identical retained experiences

whether transfer probes can discover LoRA expert groupings for business lines | 7 public sources with a label tree as held-out reference, 4 LoRA experts; probe-derived grouping -2.43pp vs reference and indistinguishable from a uniform default | no listed area problem: probes used as an allocation instrument, main claim is expert-sharing allocation, not representation understanding

asynchronous RL updates on stale rollouts have heavy-tailed importance weights that collapse effective sample size and destabilize gradients | TETPO tempers each weight rho^alpha with a per-group data-adaptive exponent meeting a target ESS fraction, with deterministic weight-dispersion and gradient-norm bounds; math-reasoning benchmarks under high staleness vs fixed-intervention stabilizers

LEST treats documented safety claims as specifications and mutates prompts to find Refuse-to-Comply counterexamples | Claude Opus 4.8 + GPT-5.5 system cards, 1,836 mutated prompts, 19 validated transitions | excluded: model-side safety testing, explicitly out of scope, and third-party testing of someone else's model

INT4 KV-cache quantization in RLVR rollouts shifts the sampler and degrades learning even with token-level truncated importance sampling | calibration-free INT4 + selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context; Qwen3-8B/4B-Base GRPO over 400 iterations, 1.80x rollout and 1.27x full-iteration speedup, final accuracy within 0.5pp of BF16 rollout under a BF16 evaluator

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: grader configuration changes and host differences could invalidate coding-agent leaderboard and self-improvement verdicts | two preregistered re-execution studies: SWE-bench Pro 59 accepted Go patches (0 rejections, 4.95% upper confidence limit), 1,929 Darwin Goedel Machine archive evaluations preserving best-agent selection and ranking, 0.83% majority-verdict flips on rebuilt images; negative results reported honestly

KV-cache compression damage is invisible to perplexity-based evaluation and a polar-guided quantizer plus consistency-anchored pruner fail their claims | EdgeLLM-Nano 8.39M-param testbed with LCDF token-by-token teacher-forced log-loss across seeds; RTN control causes an order of magnitude less damage than the polar-guided quantizer; Raspberry Pi 5 shows all backends less energy-efficient than FP16

aggregate RSA obscures where LLM representations agree and what supports the agreement | NW-RSA proximity weighting places local-to-global alignment on one scale, CF-RSA tests linguistic properties via counterfactual perturbations; strong coarse-geometry agreement vs local divergence, logical-scope changes reduce alignment most

weak validity rules for robustness-test edits accept task-changing edits (e.g. swapped payee) and reject valid ones, corrupting agent robustness verdicts | executable task contracts checked before the agent runs; re-scoring 14,336 stored runs across 4 encoders: embedding thresholds admit 75-100% task-changing edits, and a MiniLM threshold flips Mistral from 64/64 to 26 genuinely vulnerable tasks

program-level self-improvement of a reel-director agent: lessons compiled into unit-tested rules (must-fail/must-pass examples), benchmark-gated playbook rewrites, human retention decisions | 111 reels including 2x2 memory ablation and 48-reel learning curve; field-learned rule catches 4 latent pre-rule defects and guards a weaker director (30 vs 5 unguarded violations)

the standard coarse-to-fine reading of the DiT depth profile is wrong; the prediction target (eps/u/x0) is the real driver and semantic signal is a by-product | target choice in the training setup predictably reshapes the curve and predicts near-optimal REPA placement across DiT backbones

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: fixed steering ignores query-specific knowledge and reasoning needs carried in internal activations | Q-NeuS: subject-guided candidate neuron space + Query-Adaptive Gate trained by Neu-GRPO with the base LLM frozen; consistent improvements across multiple LLMs and benchmarks, no task/subject labels at inference, baselines not fully named in abstract

verifier-governed recursive-improvement protocol for panvascular intervention research; recursive harness optimization specified but not executed, one fixed component audited (syntax Dice 0.475, stenosis Dice 0.231, abstention gate accepts 76.7%) | excluded: domain application without an executed self-improvement loop, which the area rejects

carbon-aware geo-distributed scheduling conflicts with latency SLOs because prior work oversimplifies queueing and continuous batching | latency-centric simulator calibrated with hardware measurements + greedy/ILP/iterative-ILP/MILP schedulers; 3 LLMs under MLPerf SLOs, MILP cuts carbon up to 60% vs round-robin at 3% average SLO violation

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: standard on-policy distillation weights every token equally even when the teacher preference does not improve task reward | Reward-Aligned Distillation differentiates through a temporary optimizer step to score each token and updates weights by projected ascent; +6.5pp over strongest baselines on six competition-math benchmarks (Qwen3-1.7B), LiveCodeBench-v6 pass@1 54.69%/58.67%, +8.7/+6.4 points

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: execution used only as terminal reward discards learning structure in executable tasks | learning after execution with action-specific credit (initial action from final outcome, corrective action from intermediate state) vs continued single-stage GRPO; 92.70% vs 88.25% single-call success on 945 held-out Image-to-TikZ examples, corrective capability not reproduced by continued training

taxonomy of recursive self-improvement methods (9 design dimensions) plus mapping to classical deep learning mechanisms and benchmarks | no evaluation | excluded: position/taxonomy paper without evaluation, which the area rejects

LLM-derived relational priors improve sample efficiency of mixed-variable Bayesian optimization for scientific discovery | chemistry and materials formulation tasks under fixed evaluation budgets | excluded: domain application (chemistry/materials optimization) without a self-improvement loop, which the area rejects

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: group-relative terminal advantages give no guidance on which intermediate decisions to adjust, and unfavorable decision patterns recur during training | PEARL localizes first divergence between continuations, clusters branch features in success/failure memories, and selectively strengthens negative advantages; ALFWorld 97.9% success at 4B (+2.7 over strongest baseline), beats ARPO on AppWorld at 4B and 8B

expert shape and layerwise capacity allocation as MoE design axes: Jacobian-rank bound favoring near-square experts, intrinsic-dimension-guided depth allocation | lower validation loss and stronger downstream performance vs layer-homogeneous baselines at matched parameters/FLOPs | no listed area problem: architecture design, not MoE routing/load instability

streaming speech assistants launch tools from superseded arguments, leaving irreversible stale execution even after the final call is corrected | RASSG launches on 3 identical ASR results and cancels via calibrated invalidity risk at the last feasible moment; ReCAST/FDB-v3/Audio2Tool, stale execution 50.00% -> 3.15% vs LocalAgreement-2 on ReCAST prospective-repair subset

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: length-normalized single-rollout policy updates can reverse the expected ascent direction and decrease task success | exact ascent threshold for a 3-outcome softmax; unbiased third-order U-statistic vs a plug-in estimator with opposite expected sign for batch sizes 2-49; exact policy-grid enumeration and a branching process confirm initial return loss

principle-evolving agents act on every anomaly, so unverified evidence rewrites persistent principles and biases evolution | Triage-PiEvo: anomaly-responsive search portfolio + staged verification gate as sole writer of principle state; 4 scientific tasks x 3 backbones, +7.5-11.8% over strongest baseline, admits none of the corrupted/hidden-source/exploit evidence in stress tests, cuts false admissions >60% across 3 external harnesses

self-improving synthesis loop refines reusable data-synthesis instructions from trial feedback for embedding-model training | 24 retrieval datasets across 15 domains, beats human calibration on 4 of 6 tasks, scales to 32x data | excluded: the loop improves synthesis instructions for embedding models, not a self-evolving LLM agent or research loop as the area defines them

existing 2-bit vector quantization still degrades real-world tasks; sensitive-channel protection and bit-budget splitting are underexplored | SAGE: Energy-Stratified Grouping couples grouping with activation-weighted fitting, Adaptive Bit Split balances direction-codebook vs radius precision per matrix; Qwen3-30B-A3B retains 95.3% of BF16 average score, 2.55x end-to-end speedup with custom CUDA kernel

ASIWorld persistent survival sandbox evaluates sustained goal execution across 9 agent configurations (task success, achievements, survival costs) | excluded: pure agent benchmark, which the area rejects

EvoCowork: 240-task benchmark of harness-level recursive self-improvement across office modalities; ACE/AHE in-domain gains (+4.90/+2.64) do not transfer to cross-office workflows (+0.03/-1.72) | excluded: benchmark-type paper, which the area rejects

reproduce ICLR 2025 claims that unsupervised adversarial fine-tuning improves CLIP visual interpretability (saliency quality, concept alignment, OOD transfer) | reproduction plus saliency-guided extension with an Energy Pointing Game loss; localization improves at modest zero-shot/robustness cost (small at w_s=0.2, moderate at 0.6)

RSI claims are hard to falsify: did improvement come from designer-provided or machine-authored mechanisms | pre-registered two-tier genesis accounting (M1 content instances, M2 machine-authored mechanism types with held-out-validation certificates); first audited M2 events: Rydberg operator (held-out R^2 -0.546 best standard transform vs 1.0000000 composed), Kepler velocity law, audited 1.109x compounding; honest tally on blind genesis exams is zero

real applications cannot be used for training at scale (restricted access, non-resettable state) | Terrarium synthesizes executable App Worlds and tasks with evaluator-side outcome rubrics validated through agent rollouts; 275 worlds / 13,344 tasks for outcome-based RL; Qwen3 4B/8B/14B gain +18.34pp on tau^2-bench and +10.94pp on AppWorld

instruction-oriented task synthesis fabricates low-fidelity environments while resource-oriented synthesis degrades instructions into trivial operations | WorkBorne uses artifact transitions to discover grounded input-output agentic tasks; 1,061 corpora / 7,882 task environments / 15,485 trajectories (53.6% over 30 turns); Terminal-Bench 2.1 43.1% -> 61.8% on Qwen3.5-27B, beats TMax, RST, Terminal-Universe

SkillForgeBench: 842 sandboxed tasks from agent skill specifications across 5 professional domains; all-constraints satisfaction 12.6-40.9% vs per-rubric 70.0-85.7%, Opus 4.8 leads at 40.9% | excluded: pure agent benchmark, which the area rejects

TLA+ specifications translated to Verus via a deterministic transpiler plus an agentic LLM translator producing machine-checkable safety/liveness proofs | evaluation dataset maps current model capability in Verus theorem proving; no baseline comparison | no listed area problem: software-verification automation

ultra-low-bit scalar quantization loses predictive fidelity at 2 bits where few reconstruction levels must still yield consistent predictions | FidelityQ: Information-Aligned Analytic Coding (randomized Hadamard mixing + mirrored four-level minimum-distortion quantizer) and Knowledge-Intensive Calibration on the heavy-tailed teacher-student divergence; LLaMA-2-7B W2A16 WikiText2 perplexity 6.62, improves prior state of the art

unidirectional sequence-level pipeline schedules cap long-sequence training throughput and bidirectional scheduling risks communication deadlock | BSIPipe co-schedules two opposing V-shaped interleaved pipelines with activation-memory-invariant basic-unit concatenation, topology-aware device mapping and communication-computation overlap; GPT and LLaMA3, 1.11-1.13x average speedup over SOTA sequence-level baselines

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: standard on-policy distillation assigns similar importance to template phrases and visually irrelevant tokens as to grounded ones, and sequence-level GRPO rewards give poor token credit | VC-OPD uses the original-vs-counterfactual-image teacher gap to estimate token-level visual dependence and reweight the distillation loss with mass-preserving normalization after a teacher-supervised warm start; improves multimodal reasoning benchmarks vs OPD

relevance-filtered context matches full-history personalization accuracy with 5% of the text | PersonaMem-v2 (180 questions), GPT-5.6-terra and Claude Opus 5.5 judges; oracle restricted to retrieved evidence beats full history by 15.6 points | no listed area problem: context-selection efficiency finding, no silent failure or detection/repair claim

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: reasoning-tool seesaw: joint RL training of reasoning and tool use improves one objective while the other deteriorates | MCPDisCo Thought-MDP with token-masked reward attribution and bidirectional gradient surgery; trained on real interactions across 70 MCP servers and 527 tools, monotone OOD gains on MCP-Atlas and GAIA with fewer chain-of-thought tokens

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: activation-steering memory can only preserve question-independent content: facts stored as late-layer shifts are almost never reused (<=15% clean use vs 96-98% in context), and a stored dislike is recalled as a like unless the opposite reference is subtracted | pre-registered study on Qwen3.5-2B/9B with judges from 4 model families; ~98% of unrelated replies unchanged

AlphaRLM trains LLMs with RL to construct executable symbolic alpha factors from financial literature | CSI 300/1000 and S&P 500, beats factor-mining and LLM baselines in annualized excess return | excluded: domain application (quant finance) without a self-improvement loop, which the area rejects

SkillHorizon: 1,050 long-horizon tasks built by skill composition in 7 business environments; mean local-goal completion falls 90.4% -> 46.8% as workloads grow from 64K to 1M tokens | excluded: pure agent benchmark, which the area rejects

pairwise semantic relations in attention lack separation into globally consistent direction, local circulation around compositions, and harmonic flow around unfilled cycles | HodgePhaseNet: discrete Hodge decomposition of an antisymmetric 1-cochain with explicit projectors, integrability/gauge results, verified numerics, and a causality-preserving attention bias invariant to edge orientation

recurrent algorithmic reasoners reproduce every training hint yet fail on deep graphs (premature flood); two failure routes traced and removed by clamping the degree input, dense training graphs, or detaching state | SALSA-CLRS BFS with GRU/GIN/PGN processors; 0 of 23 seeds flood with detached state vs 6 under full backpropagation | no listed area problem: test-time generalization failure of small-graph reasoners, not large-scale training-run instability or monitoring

Trace Evolution Bench separates frozen-rescore artifacts from genuine context/weight updates with seed-specific bands; 7 of 9 text-update cells positive on DeepSeek v4 Pro, no method above its band on all seeds of all three models | excluded: benchmark-type paper, which the area rejects

learning effective tool invocation relies on curated QA pairs or expert demonstrations | Marvo: challenger generates QA from unlabeled images, margin reward (solver performance with vs without tools) creates an adaptive curriculum for the RL-trained solver; up to +7.1% average accuracy across agentic reasoning, visual search, math and real-world benchmarks

post-training quantization below INT8 degrades accuracy under the fixed-point encoding constraint | VLCQ relaxes it with variable-length coding, no training data or fine-tuning; per-channel: up to 6x compression at >=FP32 accuracy and 12.25x at <4% degradation vs FP32, up to 1.7x compression vs PWLQ, competitive with DFQ per-tensor across classification/segmentation/detection

cross-family KV-cache transfer (SwaT) enables prefill-free multi-agent communication | beats text-to-text by a mean 40% accuracy and 4x wall-clock across 17 benchmarks, 12 LLMs, 6 families; <50M tokens and <1 GPU-day to train, both models frozen | no listed area problem: a new communication mechanism with accuracy gains, no precision/correctness failure evaluated

elastic pretraining with dense-core/shell hidden dimensions plus muE scaling that provably keeps all subnetworks maximally updated and transfers hyperparameters from a small proxy | outperforms MatFormer and elastic baselines at matched parameter counts | no listed area problem: pretraining architecture and parameterization design, not run monitoring, instability or failure detection

Lumen-bench: say-do gap in tool-calling ethics across 30 models, 5 languages, 194,400 trials; neutral prompt raises pooled violations 2.76% -> 13.64%, 8.57% of substantive calls pair refusal with a harmful tool call | excluded: model-side safety evaluation, explicitly out of scope

per-step recurrent-state quantization sits inside the recurrence so errors compound: INT4 leaves synthetic recall intact at the start and destroys it ~1000 steps later | scale-state feedback mechanism; yoking the quantizer scale to a full-precision reference removes norm explosion entirely but recovers only 1.8 of 5.4 nats; at 32K, group-wise INT4 is worth no more than discarding the state; outlier-aware schemes lose to plain persistent scaling

single-objective, monolithic harness evolution handles competing goals poorly and mixes transferable design with environment-specific adaptation | Harmony Harness: decomposition-based multi-objective evolutionary search over the Pareto frontier plus factorized evolution operators (general mechanisms vs benchmark-specific) and dynamic composition; gains exceeding 10% on SecRepoBench and BaxBench over strong harness-evolution baselines

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: delayed prompt injection appended to telemetry the operator must read can make life-critical keep-alive agents abandon their duty and cut life support | NASA-derived BioSim lunar habitat with persistence requirement; Claude configurations mostly refuse, GPT partially susceptible, Grok cuts life support under trusted-commission framing; attack potency varies with source framing

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: a misinterpreted early update corrupts the assistant's working state by ruling out the true intent, and later turns fail without a visible error | Loci probabilistically localizes corrupting updates and applies a retain/verify/remove repair policy; beats baselines in a controlled injected-error setup with larger advantage under multiple errors, and recovers free-form conversations needing fewer interactions

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: non-prefix KV-cache reuse in RAG composes context-conditioned causal states that are not reusable text: prefix-conditioned composition preserves only 47.2% of HotpotQA-500 and 37.8% of 2Wiki-500 full-prefill answers | SAFE-KV repairs by re-encoding the causal suffix with risk-guided K2 selection, restoring 99.8-100%; unrepaired reuse degrades at 16 documents where suffix repair recovers 98-100% (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct)

whether LLMs internally differentiate linguistic traits such as conventional vs idiomatic meaning | layer-wise probing plus PCA-ranked geometric distance on Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma-3-1B-PT; equal-capacity models organize linguistic information in fundamentally different ways

unchecked intermediate findings propagate errors through long multi-step research investigations | PANINI-DR: shared Generative Semantic Workspace records subquestions/findings/evidence and a separate verification agent checks answers before reuse; BrowseComp-Plus 73.3% (+16.0 over next-best of 7 harnesses with a shared backbone), strongest on hard questions, highest evidence recoverability

running recurrent-depth LMs at reduced loop counts removes refusal while harmfulness remains linearly decodable in the state (probe ROC AUC 0.967 vs 0.986 at full depth) | four released Ouro checkpoints plus Huginn-0125; removing a single internal direction drops refusal 0.950 -> 0.130; random-depth training restores harmful/harmless separation (+0.399) where early-exit and per-request depth fail

joint harness evolution across multi-agent systems overwhelms a single global optimizer as context and workload grow and internals cannot be shared | HarnessNet: Agentron units (evolvable harness + frozen model + local optimizer) in a layered graph with backward node-specific feedback; AgentBench gains comparable to a global optimizer with fewer tokens per optimizer call, and evolved harnesses transfer across foundation models

characterizing when non-Euclidean gradient descent diverges: the intermediate regime 2/S < eta < 2/mu can contain arbitrarily many distinct edges of stability with different attracting directions | linear conjugacy reduction; Hilbertian norms are the only a.e.-sharp thresholds for every positive-definite quadratic; smooth 2D constructions with arbitrarily large threshold separation; theory only, no training-run experiments

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: self-evolving memory lets backdoor payloads stay dormant and activate only after deployment-time evolution, defeating static scanning with clean memory (0.5% attack success before evolution, >95% within 100 interactions) | EvolvAttack memory-aware backdoor training across 3 VLM backbones, 4 agent pipelines, and recency/semantic/reward-based memory evolution while preserving benign behavior

sequential tool execution inflates agentic RL rollout latency | ObsSpec predicts tool outputs with a 0.6B world model, retaining speculation only on exact match (66.4% exact rate, ~16x faster), cutting agent latency 9.3-14.2% for 8B/32B policies | no listed RL failure/dynamic: rollout latency optimization

verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation plus preference optimization for SMT-LIB reasoning agents with Z3 in the loop | 4B model 85.6% -> 97.0% per-attempt accuracy, pass^4 64.1% -> 91.7% across 37 benchmarks / 7,254 problems per family | no listed area problem: formal-reasoning capability post-training

low-bit quantization errors accumulate along long reasoning trajectories because standard calibration sees only short segments without the earlier context later steps read | RECAP: dynamic-prefix calibration regenerates prefix KV with the current quantizer and rotates the active block; prefix read geometry supervises historical cache errors by their attention effect; W4A4KV4 +13.3pp MATH500 (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) and +15.8pp AIME-120 (Qwen3-4B) over baseline

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: correct outputs can rest on unstable latent knowledge representations | latent state stability (LSS) and knowledge topology stability (KTS) on EpiStableBench (4,411 items, 76,766 controlled queries, 16 LLMs from 4 families); stability varies substantially among correctly answered items, within-model stability predicts held-out elicitation accuracy, and LatentDPO learns edits accounting for stability

verifier-guided backtracking (CS-VGB) for continuous generative models provably converges to the reward-tilted target despite inaccurate intermediate verifiers | denoising/renoising pairing with exponential convergence and linear update count; ImageNet, CelebA, multi-robot planning | no listed area problem: inference-time scaling robustness for diffusion sampling

low-bit post-training quantization degrades autoregressive visual generation quality | training-free HGA-Quant: tail-aware bounded-init grid refinement for weight calibration + coarse-to-fine activation precision scheduling; on Infinity, near full-precision quality at effective W4A5.6 while existing methods at W4A6 still degrade

LLM-designed KV-cache quantization transfers poorly to autoregressive video models with spatiotemporal statistics | TempoKV exploits temporal predictability: keys predicted from temporal history, values from a short value history, storing low-precision residuals with offline linear-regression calibration; Self-Forcing/Causal Forcing/LongCat-Video-13B, up to 6.71x KV compression with the best quality-efficiency tradeoff

coding benchmarks need costly human curation or LLM generation and validation | CodeWalk composes verified atomic problems into level-N tasks kept only if each atomic problem stays unsolved and a joint reference solution passes the evaluation-time check; 4 settings (multi-bug repair, proof completion, complexity analysis, clone equivalence); frontier models degrade with depth, RFT improves Qwen3.5-9B at every level

design-space exploration of inference clusters needs latency prediction under KV reuse, location, capacity and contention, which isolated profiles cannot give | compositional discrete-event simulator separating local service costs from shared KV availability; calibrated 1P-1D models reused across workers; validated vs SGLang on Qwen3-8B/32B (1.34% / 6.36% latency MAPE), 15.33x faster than replay

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: terminal reward barely attributes failure to earlier steps, so an ill-judged edit corrupts repository state before any signal arrives | ANTE verifies pre-action beliefs by real execution and turns them into per-step credit (Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization) plus test-time action selection; Qwen3-32B SWE-bench Verified 25.0% -> 57.2% pass@1, +6.2pp over matched GRPO, world-model accuracy 44% -> 69% during RL

RL across four verifiable task environments improves math/science/instruction following but degrades Indic extractive QA because rewards do not require the requested language: English-answer share rises 8.7% -> 91.7% | scoped Indic reward restores the language convention; a 26B-A4B generative judge beats a 235B model on RM-Bench and distillation restores 81% of displaced capabilities; 30B-A3B hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE

capability lost to model size and compression can be recovered by verified parallel retry under idle local hardware | 7B Qwen with 8 attempts essentially matches a 32B model on MBPP+ and exceeds it on 3 other code benchmarks at ~4x less memory, up to 6x faster and less energy; consistent across sizes, compression levels and GPUs

in-place Indic tokenizer expansion (131,072 -> 163,072 entries) and continual pretraining (~1.27T tokens) for 8 Indian languages; +12.9 Indic MILU, -3.4 English MMLU; negative results: direct token addition underperforms, AdamW weight decay moves frozen rows, holdout perplexity misselects LR | excluded: language-adaptation technical report, not an official system card of a frontier-lab general-purpose model

2-bit scalar KV quantization is unstable and 3-bit keys are needed to preserve quality | E8 lattice vector quantization for keys exploits adjacent-dimension correlations for higher SQNR at the same payload, with table-based asymmetric scoring at decode-throughput parity; 5 LLM families, ~6x KV compression, near-baseline long-context perplexity, beats scalar k3v2 in 80% of model-dataset-context settings

harness evolution for video understanding previously needed annotated QA or weight updates | VideoEvoHarness jointly evolves Questioner and Solver harnesses from unlabeled videos with frozen models: reference answers from video memory, failure-trace-guided revisions, validation-gated retention; higher accuracy on a disjoint benchmark set, transfers across backbones, improves across rounds

photonic matrix-multiplier inference accuracy degrades under laser relative-intensity noise, thermal/phase drift and their joint action | Mach-Zehnder vs microring comparison on CIFAR-10 CNN and ResNet-8 mapped to matched photonic MAC chains; RIN-only and drift-only sweeps plus a 2D grid at 0.5-20% RMS with confusion matrices and response surfaces

whether internal representations encode the long-horizon value of next-token candidates at a reasoning prefix | sparse linear probes over hidden states/MLP/attention outputs on the RCTV dataset (math prefixes + plausible candidates + empirical long-horizon values); linearly decodable at multiple layers, probes beat probability- and embedding-based baselines, and decoded signals guide token selection in a controlled intervention

host-to-device expert transfers in offloaded MoE put speculative decoding on the critical path, sometimes making it slower than autoregressive decoding | SpecFit selects the verified draft subtree maximizing predicted throughput via a submodular expert-union cost and exact ancestor-closed search, also deciding when to stop drafting; Qwen3-30B-A3B, 21.6%/7.0% faster than EAGLE-3 and 1.97x/1.72x vs vanilla EAGLE-3

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: communication faults (loss, delay, partial content) alter task-relevant information while messages stay processable, so failures go unsignaled: 20.7% of failures with detection records lack an immediate signal, 76.2% for partial-content faults | fault-injection and tracing pipeline over 29,000+ executions, 100 tasks, 5 domains, 3 topologies; flat topology keeps 53.0% success vs 3.3%/3.2% for sequential/hierarchical; evidence protection recovers cases execution-side mechanisms miss

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: independently authored skills jointly loaded impose incompatible requirements, competing preferences and redundant instructions on the agent | SkillFusion offline compiler reconciles them via typed scoped constraints, an interaction classifier and adversarial verifier, conditional routing/priorities and dedup; over 2.5x the Success of unresolved multi-skill loading at the largest configurations, highest non-oracle Success on 3 agent and 2 transfer benchmarks across 3 executor models

continual skill internalization forgets in two stages: invocation from the raw request fails first (skill-addressing forgetting), then conditional execution degrades (skill-execution forgetting) | Factorized Skill Memory: frozen LoRA executors appended to a stable Execution Memory plus an incremental Address Memory, no replay; 5-stage benchmark from 100 TaskBench skills, 65.95% EM / 93.38% addressing, +14.3pp over the strongest replay-free parameter-isolation baseline

interindividual variation in human concept representations measured via sentence embeddings (sharedness and idiosyncrasy) | N=125 participants, crossed random effects, replication across 3 encoders, pre-registered | no listed area problem: human semantic-variation study using embeddings as an instrument, not LLM internal-representation analysis

decisions.anchor: corruption of model outputs caused by the numerics, kernels or serving stack underneath the model
decisions.reason: cross-model KV transport with high reconstruction fidelity still produces different attention patterns, predictive distributions and accuracy: fidelity is a poor proxy for receiver utility | CacheLink learns a coupled K/V correction through receiver behavior (<0.4% change in K/V squared error with large behavioral change); 4 independently trained sender-receiver pairs, 7 evaluation panels, up to 7.27x handoff latency reduction at 32K vs re-prefill

black-box evolutionary red-teaming (REPRO) with semantic crossover and Thompson-sampling strategy selection; 100% ASR under its own protocol on 36 targets | excluded: model-side safety/red-teaming research, explicitly out of scope

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: local protocol-attack success does not predict downstream consequence in long-horizon MAS: local ASR >=90% while consequence conversion ranges 7.1-100.0% | Agent-Canary-Mas: matched malicious-benign end-to-end evaluation over A2A/ANP/BCS with 975 pairs in 5 domains; cross-agent evidence raises Audit-F1 29.7% -> 95.5%; protocol-context Guard cuts Finance ASR 86.1% -> 53.8% with a completion tradeoff

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: schema-valid choices driven by poisoned retrieval context trigger policy-violating executions, and defenses can silently withhold correct automation | execution-aware protocol tracing; 1,659 fresh calls to Jev-1.13.0 across 20 tasks, 3 reps; standalone payload reaches 60/60 trials with 5 violations; adding correct evidence cuts wrong executions 119/120 -> 55/120; source-exclusion gate blocks 1 violation but withholds 10 attacked and 16 clean correct decisions

decisions.anchor: official system cards, technical reports, and safety evaluations of frontier general-purpose models (LLMs, VLMs, agents) from major AI labs
decisions.reason: technical report of the fully open Apertus 1.5 multimodal reasoning family from public institutions: continued pretraining on +4T/+2T tokens (8B/70B), 262,144-token context, RLVR and preference alignment; thinking-as-template lifts math up to +20 on 8B; leads fully open models of its class on knowledge, instruction following and cultural benchmarks, trained only on openly available data

decisions.anchor: precision and correctness problems introduced by aggressive optimization of training and inference
decisions.reason: pruning and recovery stages designed in isolation compose badly; instruction-following collapses first under pruning, before knowledge, reasoning or core LM ability | sweeps of ordering, stage-driving data and objective alignment; in-domain data is the strongest pruning signal while instruction-style data recovers the most; importance-ranking drift analyzed before and after pruning

decisions.anchor: precision and correctness problems introduced by aggressive optimization of training and inference
decisions.reason: calibration-set choice for MoE expert pruning is largely misunderstood | gpt-oss-20b layer-wise expert pruning under calibration size, language and distribution perturbations; scaling calibration data beyond small sizes gives minimal benefit, English-only calibration transfers across 7 languages, and pretraining-like diverse data matches or beats test-distribution data

screening collapse: recursive synthetic-data labeling drifts the screening target until the active-inactive margin erodes or reverses and variables are discarded | Gaussian linear theory with minimax impossibility, mitigations via real-label retention and data accumulation; gene-expression numerics | no listed area problem: statistical screening theory, not LLM training-run stability

mixed-precision serving allocators using average bit-width or memory budgets mispredict speed because the binding resource shifts among compute, weight loading and KV access by phase, batch size and context | calibrated cost model used both as latency predictor (3 hardware classes) and as a dynamic-programming allocator with measured per-tensor accuracy costs, compared against byte-aware and sensitivity-only allocation

mixed-precision configurations chosen for short context are suboptimal at longer context where KV reads crowd out weight time | context-aware precision scheduling: calibrated timing model + tensor sensitivities under latency or accuracy budgets; laptop-GPU schedules with three weight formats and a tool-use benchmark measuring full response time and correctness; quantized-KV error sets the remaining weight-precision budget

one-step generative policy (DriftSpread) for online maximum-entropy RL via critic-guided Drift and entropy-induced Spread | highest aggregate normalized return on MuJoCo vs diffusion/flow baselines with better training and inference efficiency | no listed area problem: continuous-control RL, not LLM post-training dynamics

quantized VLA policies (QAT and PTQ) leave substantial gaps to full precision on long-horizon tasks and under visual/semantic shift | Quantization-Conditioned RL: offline RL with progress-scaled advantages and quantization-aware source conditioning; 5 VLA models, 4,050 real trials; 99.3% of FP score (INT4 W4A16, pi_0.5) and 100.7% (NVFP4 W4A4) with 42.9% memory saving and 1.73x speedup on Jetson Thor

applying RL to a new task still needs human expertise to design observations, rewards, algorithms and training configuration | FARL jointly searches observation/reward programs, algorithms and training settings, diagnosing failures from training statistics with a staged budget; Adroit Hand Relocate 97.1% success at 5M steps vs 0% for Eureka and LiMEN and 1.0% for native PPO

recursive refinement of behavioral specifications suffers output coupling: improving one entity's spec degrades others (whack-a-mole regressions) | SpecForge: multi-frontier tree search with Pareto-guided state selection, dependency-constrained callee-before-caller refinement, and error-diversified expansion; DevEval+ 94.9% solve rate with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and +5.7pp average over the strongest baseline across 5 backbones

recurrent-state quantization errors are highly coherent across steps because small updates are lost in rounding, and state elements can move opposite to their update | Low-Rank Bypass accumulates small updates in a low-rank buffer with periodic merges; Bounded Directional Rounding rounds reversed elements toward their updates; training-free, beats INT4 on Gated DeltaNet/GLA/Mamba2/RetNet, 5.3x state-memory reduction and 1.9x decode speedup vs FP32 states

cross-model KV cache reuse deviates from the receiver's native safety behavior; value reuse deviates more than key reuse across all pairs | VReparo per-layer/per-head affine alignment cuts HarmBench ASR 57.28% -> 39.21% and StrongREJECT 0.4215 -> 0.2163 while keeping 85.62% TTFT reduction | excluded: the evaluated claim is the model's safety behavior, which both candidate areas explicitly put out of scope

strict preservation of temporal-GNN event dependencies limits parallelism and forces expensive cross-GPU memory synchronization | DepBloom: temporally bounded spatial partitioning, intra-batch memory refinement for short-range dependencies, and critical-path prioritization; 2.84x average and up to 5.16x speedup over state-of-the-art multi-GPU TGNN training with comparable or better model quality

LLM optimizers re-propose already-rejected candidates in their own loop states, wasting 28-63% of valid iterations, and clean-state probes underpredict this (loop-minus-probe rate 0.32 [0.27, 0.37]) | 3 open LLMs improving a GUI agent over a 40-edit catalog; a loop's rejected edits are its own earlier choices; stating rejection status lowers re-proposal in every model (-0.16 [-0.22, -0.09])

temporal consistency losses suppress sample accumulation in learned real-time supersampling when registration is accurate; four registration errors conceal the effect | model-free oracle plus controlled training across 3 network families and 2 scales; registered network improves QRISP by 0.34-0.62 dB and beats DLSS 2 static-pixel stability 4x | no listed area problem: rendering/graphics training study

interface properties (discoverability, granularity, observability) drive agent performance on desktop software; ANIS synthesizes agent-native interfaces (+3.8/+3.5pp over native SDK, ~73% fewer tokens; goal-level commands reach 74.5%/67.4%) | DeskIF-Bench 255 tasks / 6 apps, expanded evaluation 368 tasks / 8 apps | no listed area problem: agent-environment interface engineering without a self-improvement loop or harness-failure claim

prior RLVR + on-policy self-distillation overlooks the on-policy evolution of agentic skills and the reliability of skill-conditioned teacher scores | RSIPO: the policy extracts skills from trajectories and optimizes skill generation through trajectory replay, with empirical-Bayes shrinkage calibrating trust in teacher scores; Qwen2.5-7B reaches 98.6% on ALFWorld (+2.5 over the second-best baseline, +17.4 over GRPO)

GRPO against a frozen reference-free LLM judge raises training-rollout accuracy but yields no held-out greedy gain in all 12 cells — the policy exploits the judge's false positives | gold-reward control gives +0.054 [0.013, 0.096] for the 1.5B policy; hacking depth tracks judge AUC (Spearman -0.69 over 12 cells) rather than the policy-judge gap; 0.5B/1.5B Qwen2.5 policies against judges up to 8B

fixed-model annotation lags the evolving navigation policy, so generated supervision goes stale | RSI-Nav: policy-synchronized language-action dual bootstrapping processes unlabeled trajectories in shards — generate instructions, execute, retain qualified samples, update before the next shard; 68.6% SR on R2R-CE and 72.4% SR on RxR-CE with stronger instruction-generation utility after evolution

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: plan/revise/test pipelines pass their own tests while missing the task semantics (interpretive lock-in): test-pass counts rise 22/30 -> 29-30/30 yet no solution matches its stored reference output | 30 TPC-DS DataFrame tasks; Frozen One-Pass vs Test-Guided vs PlanAudit-Guided revision; evaluator controls 57/57 correct; same-engine SQL re-execution reproduces 28/30 references; 25/25 false passes in fresh generation

deep-learning framework bugs involving data flow (autodiff, operator fusion) produce incorrect results that topology-only testing cannot surface | Tensor Flow Graph captures runtime tensor states and operator input requirements; FlowMuT mutation testing with LinUCB selection and data-flow legality constraints; PyTorch and MindSpore, 55 bug reports (41 developer-confirmed, 7 fixed), 43.4% higher data-flow diversity than the strongest baseline

benchmarking GRU/Transformer/TimesNet/Autoformer anomaly detectors on IBM Cloud Console telemetry with the timing-aware NAB metric; TimesNet best early detection, modest overall differences | no listed area problem: microservice telemetry anomaly detection, not ML-cluster node/accelerator failure detection or straggler handling

how shared internal representations become specialized in minimal artificial learners, with Adam second-moment state governing latent susceptibility | controlled interventions on toy learners (reset/exchange moments, equalized scaling) | no listed area problem: learning-dynamics theory on toy learners, not probing or interpreting LLM representations

whether next-token prediction alone develops taxonomic property induction and how it is organized internally | fact-injection continued pretraining of Pythia and OLMo 2 (70M-7B) on a synthetic latent taxonomy; clustering recovers the full taxonomic tree from activations; induction weakens with model size at a fixed data budget, suggesting memorization over compression

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: long-horizon sparse-reward agentic RL cannot credit individual actions: GRPO assigns one trajectory-level advantage and learned critics are costly and unstable | LVRL uses a frozen LLM value model conditioned on group context, calibrated at initial/terminal states, for step-level credit; LVOPD focuses OPD supervision on value-decreasing actions; +13.6pp AppWorld and +8.6pp SWE-bench Verified over GRPO, BabyAI 0 -> 75.0%, Monte-Carlo check of critic accuracy

observational SAE feature-discovery scores generally do not identify intervention attribution (the first-order effect of steering/ablation on output) | exact gradient-based decomposition of the probe-vs-attribution gap; 4 model-SAE pairs with probe-to-attribution magnitude ratios of tens to hundreds; sign match 91-97% for gradient attribution vs 17-35% for probe-implied changes on nonzero ablations

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: what makes an image token a visual attention sink | only centered cosine similarity between the image token's key and the LM's text-sink key detects sinks across 10 VLMs from 4 families (6 candidate detectors); moving the sink's key back to the image-key median restores text-sink attention without changing answers; entropy-triggered re-look adds +4.3 mean fine-detail VQA

false retry permission: agents retry timed-out tool calls without support from the visible contract, separable from realized recovery | RetryBench controls on fixed GPT endpoints: changed keys elicit unsupported retries in Terra 55/80 and Luna 60/80 vs Sol 1/80; removing the weak-contract label and explicit-contract cue controls (deferral 762/762) across 720/240/1,536-response blocks

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training (RLVR, GRPO/PPO, on-policy distillation, asynchronous RL)
decisions.reason: fixed state sampling spends RLVR rollout budget on states that yield no learning signal | variance-optimal Neyman allocation mu ∝ d^pi(s) sigma_pi(s) connects to GRPO's group-relative advantages and induces an emergent reverse curriculum; VSR is a GRPO plug-in with a prefix replay buffer and zero-cost variance proxy, beating GRPO and GiGPO on math reasoning and Sokoban/BabyAI with fewer tokens per update

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: generator-reviewer pipelines misattribute capability transfer as verification: review beats the stronger model alone in only 9 of 96 review directions, and the reviewer mostly follows the generator, discarding its own correct answers | 48 pairs of 12 open-weight models (3B-72B) across math, knowledge, code and reasoning; review costs 2.6-2.8x the stronger model alone while a same-two-call selector is 2.7-4.2pp more accurate and cheaper

whether lightweight decode scheduling changes latency-throughput tradeoffs without model, kernel or learned-scheduler changes | continuous-batching testbench with real Hugging Face execution; 1,152 GPU-model-scheduler-workload runs (6 Qwen/Gemma/Mistral models; Modal L40S/A100/H100; ShareGPT-derived traffic); aging shortest-prompt-first is the strongest practical baseline; oracle remaining-length shows job-size knowledge alone is insufficient

deep-research agents stop prematurely, continue after sufficient evidence, or fail to redirect unproductive trajectories | RIVO: state-conditioned trajectory correction via logit intervention on the host with a local-improvement guarantee, trained from downstream outcomes, plus the BrowseCore paired-corpus dataset; gains across multiple deep-research benchmarks (numbers truncated in abstract)

reusable skills for multimodal agents depend on both the evidence presented and the procedure that reads it | ViewCraft jointly evolves an executable evidence interface and its reading procedure with failure-trace-guided revisions, replay/paired-evaluation retention and interface projection; +6.1 average points across 8 benchmarks, persists at matched token budget, uses 8-15% fewer tokens on multi-source tasks, transfers across executors

programmatic verifiers in agent environments can be attacked into awarding full credit to cheating agents, corrupting evaluation and RL training | weak-to-strong verifier hardening: isolated verifier sandbox + hacker-fixer loop applied to Terminal Bench, KernelBench and SETA, substantially reducing attack success, scaling with the hardening budget and beating a static baseline; adopted by the official Terminal Bench repo for exploit auditing

state-based predictive coding decays with depth so deep low-precision PCNs fail to train | error-based reparameterization + bidirectional PC + global-norm clipping of error gradients stabilizes training at >=8 layers; W4A4E4 quantization-aware training within ~5pp of full precision (<2pp in best FP4/posit formats); +50 accuracy points over state-based bPC at 6 layers

what an LLM judge must be shown: judges denied the material they must respect drive iterative revision below the starting point, with losses compounding across rounds | 7 benchmarks, 3 judges with 10-17x price spread, 81 preregistered clauses (32 met bar); a reference summary beside the source undoes most of the source's contribution on summarisation | no listed area problem: LLM-as-judge evaluation methodology

self-evolving agents need a dense, cheap improvement signal: repository tests alone reject only 25.3% of behavior-changing rewrites | TeSearch: quality-diversity evolutionary search over small, strong test suites with a learned transition kernel denoising the LLM actuator; 129 real-world modules and 3 backbones; rejects 59.9% of behavior-changing rewrites at a 4.0% false-alarm rate and 3.5s per decision

authority revocation reported at issuer commit or transport acknowledgment is not enforced at all gateways: under receiver-selective non-delivery, 112 of 225 calls (49.78%) are still admitted and all commit | C0-C5 executable outcome contract with a persistent monitor over a frozen gateway set; Keycloak 26.7, 8 gateways, 2 durable receivers, 16 AWS hosts; treating C3/C4 as completion yields 7/5 false positives vs none for C0-C5; reproduced with OPA/Toxiproxy and an MCPMark agent over 60 closed-loop arms
